visual.general_description: Six grayscale ocular ultrasound images arranged in two columns and three rows, each with a green arrow.
visual.detailed_description: Six separate grayscale B-mode ultrasound images of an eye are stacked in two columns and three rows with no panel letters. Each shows a rounded dark (anechoic) globe with brighter echogenic tissue behind it, and each has a green arrow pointing at a small bright echogenic spot in the tissue behind the globe, with a darker shadow trailing behind the spot in several images. The arrow in the second image of the middle row is smaller than the others, and that image has the printed word RIGHT near its upper left. The sixth image (bottom right) has a yellowish upper edge and a bluish tint, unlike the other five. No other text, scale, date or patient label is legible in the six images.
